summary: Wrapper that delegates to CMpegBase_ProcessHeader(this, a2) and returns a BOOL indicating whether it returned -1 (error/parse failure). No side effects beyond the delegated call. Called from CMpegBase_Open (0x0052E090) and CMpegFilePlayer_Open (0x0052E1D0).

operations.description: Forward this and a2 to CMpegBase_ProcessHeader at 0x0052DA30.
Return TRUE (1) when CMpegBase_ProcessHeader returned -1, otherwise FALSE (0).

unresolved: The meaning of the -1 return from CMpegBase_ProcessHeader (error code vs sentinel) is not resolved here.
The owner object is unknown; CMpegBase_Open and CMpegFilePlayer_Open are callers, not proof of ownership of this wrapper.
The canonical name ArithmeticComparison_de40 is generic; ProcessHeaderFailed is a DERIVED semantic label for review.
